subject: Java Full Stack
description: Comprehensive 120-hour Java Full Stack training covering Core Java 8, Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, React, Node.js, SQL, PL/SQL, JUnit, Git and Jenkins. Instructor-Led Classroom Training (30 sessions x 4 hrs each).

sessions.session_title: Day 1 - Core Java: Introduction & Language Fundamentals
sessions.session_description: Introduction to Java, Language Fundamentals including Primitive Data Types, Operators & Assignments, Flow Control, and Classes & Objects.

sessions.session_title: Day 2 - Core Java: Exploring Java Basics & OOP
sessions.session_description: Wrapper Classes, Type Casting, String Handling, Inheritance, Polymorphism and Abstract Classes/Interfaces.
topics: Default and static methods on Interface

sessions.session_title: Day 3 - Core Java: Exception Handling & Arrays
sessions.session_description: Complete Exception Handling lifecycle including try-catch-finally, user-defined exceptions, and one-dimensional Arrays with varargs.

sessions.session_title: Day 4 - Core Java: Collections, Generics & Property Files
sessions.session_description: Java Collections Framework, Generics, Comparable/Comparator and Property Files.
topics: Iterating Collections using foreach and iterator

sessions.session_description: Version Control with Git: from installation to collaborative workflows, branching, merging, and GitHub.
topics: Understanding Git: What is Git and Why to Use it
Git Workflow: Working with Local Repositories
Collaborative Development with Git: Working with Remote Repositories
Resolving Conflicts and Undoing Changes in Git
Introduction to Git Hosting Services (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket)

sessions.session_description: Continuous Integration and Deployment with Jenkins: jobs, pipelines, Git integration, plugins, and best practices.
topics: Understanding Jenkins: What is Jenkins and Why to Use it
Integrating Jenkins with Version Control Systems (Git)
Best Practices for Jenkins Setup and Usage

sessions.session_description: Unit Testing and Test-Driven Development with JUnit: test cases, suites, fixtures, assertions, annotations and Mockito.
topics: Introduction to Unit Testing and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
Understanding JUnit: What is JUnit and Why to Use it
Setting Up a Java Development Environment for JUnit
Writing Your First JUnit Test Cases
Test Suites and Test Fixtures in JUnit
Assertions and Test Annotations in JUnit
Best Practices for Writing Effective Unit Tests

sessions.session_description: JavaScript fundamentals, ECMAScript versions, the Document Object Model, event handling, and DOM manipulation.
topics: Which Version of JavaScript am I Using?

sessions.session_title: Day 9 - jQuery, Ajax & RESTful Web Services
sessions.session_description: jQuery library usage, Ajax calls, RESTful Web Services, HTTP verbs, XML/JSON data formats and OData.
topics: Working with the Data Returned by jQuery
Running a Function Against the jQuery Return Set

sessions.session_description: Spring Boot starters, application setup, dependency injection, component scans, configuration, context root, and logging.
topics: Spring Boot starters, CLI, Gradle plugin

sessions.session_title: Day 11 - Spring Boot Essentials & Spring Data JPA
sessions.session_description: Spring Boot Essentials (Embedded Servers, Data Access, Auto-configuration), Spring Data JPA core concepts and repository patterns.
topics: Spring Data JPA Intro and Overview

sessions.session_title: Day 12 - Spring Data REST & Spring Framework Core
sessions.session_description: Spring Data REST configuration, associations and query methods. Spring Framework core: IoC, DI, Bean scopes and lifecycle.
topics: Spring Data REST Introduction and Overview
Adding Spring Data REST to a Spring Boot Project
Repository resources, Default Status Codes, Http methods
Configuring Spring Beans using XML and annotations
DI and Inversion of Control (IoC) in Spring
Understanding Bean scopes and Lifecycle in Spring

sessions.session_description: Spring MVC architecture, DispatcherServlet, application context, controllers, request handling and JSP view rendering.
topics: Introduction to Spring MVC architecture and DispatcherServlet
Configuring Spring MVC application context and controller mappings
Creating Controller classes to handle user requests
Integrating Spring MVC with JSP for view rendering

sessions.session_description: Introduction to React ecosystem, setting up the development environment, creating your first React app, JSX syntax and components.
topics: Introduction to React and its ecosystem
Props and state in React components

sessions.session_title: Day 15 - React: Events, State Management & Lists
sessions.session_description: Event handling in React, managing state with useState/setState, component lifecycle methods, lists, keys and conditional rendering.
topics: Managing state with useState and setState
Using keys for efficient list rendering

sessions.session_title: Day 16 - React: Forms, Hooks & Context API
sessions.session_description: React forms (controlled vs uncontrolled), form validation, React hooks (useState, useEffect, custom hooks), and Context API.
topics: Working with useState, useEffect, and custom hooks
Using Context API for global state management

sessions.session_description: React Router setup, nested routes, navigation, route parameters, Redux state management, actions, reducers and store.
topics: Setting up routing in React applications
Actions, reducers, and the Redux store

sessions.session_title: Day 18 - React: Styling & API Data Fetching
sessions.session_description: CSS Modules, CSS-in-JS (styled-components), responsive design, making HTTP requests in React using useEffect and handling states.
Introduction to Node.js, why Node.js, setting up the environment, core modules, require/module.exports, and npm package management.
topics: Why Node.js? Asynchronous and Non-Blocking I/O
fs, path, os, http, url modules

sessions.session_title: Day 20 - Node.js: Routing, Error Handling & Deployment
sessions.session_description: Routing in Node.js, handling requests, URL parsing, HTTP methods, route handlers, error handling, debugging, performance optimization and deployment.
topics: Handling requests: Request-response cycle, URL parsing
Using the http module for basic routing

sessions.session_description: Deep dive into modern JavaScript: arrow functions, destructuring, spread/rest operators, promises, async/await, modules and classes.

sessions.session_title: Day 22 - Hibernate with JPA: Introduction & Entities
sessions.session_description: Introduction to data persistence, ORM tools overview, JPA specifications, Entity classes, persistent fields/properties and primary keys.
topics: Introduction and overview of data persistence
Persistent Fields and Properties in Entity Classes
Using Collections in Entity Fields and Properties

sessions.session_title: Day 23 - Hibernate with JPA: Managing Entities & Querying
sessions.session_description: EntityManager interface, container/application-managed entity managers, entity lifecycle, JPQL, Criteria API.
topics: Persisting, Removing and Synchronizing Entity Instances

sessions.session_title: Day 24 - Hibernate with JPA: Entity Relationships
sessions.session_description: Direction in entity relationships, bidirectional/unidirectional relationships, cascade operations and queries with relationships.
Relational Model, basic SQL syntax, SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE commands and querying data.
topics: How to Constrain the Result Set

sessions.session_description: WHERE clause, Boolean operators, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, HAVING, set functions and advanced filtering.
topics: Other Boolean Operators: BETWEEN, LIKE, IN, IS, IS NOT
Set Functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX)

sessions.session_description: All JOIN types (CROSS, INNER, OUTER, SELF), creating and managing database tables with DDL commands.
Introduction to PL/SQL, block structure, declaration section, execution section and conditional control structures.
topics: Declaration section: variables and data types
Handling NULL values with NULLIF and COALESCE

sessions.session_description: Hands-on full stack project integrating React frontend with Spring Boot REST API backend and MySQL/PostgreSQL database using Hibernate/JPA.
topics: Setting up Spring Boot REST API
Connecting React frontend to Spring Boot API
Axios/Fetch for API calls from React

sessions.session_description: Final capstone project presentation, code review, assessment, interview preparation and career guidance.
topics: Common Interview Questions: Spring Boot & Hibernate
